metadata.title: Windows Server 2025 Active Directory (AD) RID Manager$ object must be configured with proper audit settings.

criterion.comment: Windows Server Active Directory RID Manager$ object must be configured with proper audit settings.

independent-def:shellcommand_test.comment: Windows Server Active Directory RID Manager$ object must be configured with proper audit settings.

independent-def:shellcommand_object.comment: Query both Fail and Success auditing settings for RID Manager$
independent-def:shellcommand_object.independent-def:command: $path = 'AD:\CN=RID Manager$,CN=System,' + (Get-ADDomain).DistinguishedName; $aud = (Get-Acl $path -Audit).Audit; $hasFail = [bool]($aud | Where-Object {$_.IdentityReference -match 'Everyone|S-1-1-0' -and $_.AuditFlags -eq 'Failure' -and ($_.ActiveDirectoryRights -match 'GenericAll|FullControl|All')}); $hasSucc = [bool]($aud | Where-Object {$_.IdentityReference -match 'Everyone|S-1-1-0' -and $_.AuditFlags -eq 'Success' -and ($_.ActiveDirectoryRights -match 'ExtendedRight|WriteProperty')}); . { if (-not $hasFail -or -not $hasSucc) { $reasons = @(); if (-not $hasFail) { $reasons += 'MISSING: Everyone -> Failure -> GenericAll/FullControl audit policy' }; if (-not $hasSucc) { $reasons += 'MISSING: Everyone -> Success -> ExtendedRight/WriteProperty audit policy' }; [PSCustomObject]@{ Target_Object = $path.Replace('AD:\',''); IdentityReference = 'Everyone (S-1-1-0)'; Status = 'FAIL'; Details = ($reasons -join ' | ') } } else { [PSCustomObject]@{ Target_Object = $path.Replace('AD:\',''); IdentityReference = 'Everyone (S-1-1-0)'; Status = 'PASS'; Details = 'All mandatory Failure and Success audit policies are correctly configured per the STIG.' } } } | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 4096

independent-def:shellcommand_state.comment: No lines shall exist listed with status of 'FAIL'
